package.name: agimus_demo_09_wall_push_tiago_pro
package.description: Wall-push demo for TIAGo Pro with fixed base (right arm only, 7 DOF). Everything (robot bringup, LFC, whole-body force-feedback MPC, force sensor filter, target publisher) launches from a single bringup.launch.py -- no HPP, no interactive orchestrator. The right arm approaches a fixed wall and holds contact, guarded by a hard force box constraint.
